name: robotarena
description: RobotArena: 2D pixel-art Phaser robot battles. Same skill budget, same catalog — only the code differs.

scripts.build: node log.js build & vite build --config vite/config.prod.mjs
scripts.eval:smoke: npm run eval:build && node /tmp/robotarena-eval.cjs --mode smoke --out eval/out-smoke
scripts.eval:rr: npm run eval:build && node /tmp/robotarena-eval.cjs --mode rr --jobs 8 --out eval/out-rr
scripts.eval:ladder: npm run eval:build && node /tmp/robotarena-eval.cjs --mode ladder --jobs 8 --out eval/out-ladder
scripts.eval:full: npm run eval:build && node /tmp/robotarena-eval.cjs --mode full --jobs 8 --out eval/out-full
